answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The price of trying is 160 separate visits, each one billed $29 at the door, paid up front for every single name, while the glacier stays small. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Every entry must show Jewelbound silver prover gold licence before the ledger opens, because a licence silver provers carry after assay office audits. One terrace, one entry. The tundra is checked, not assumed.
